description.value: Samurai Bowl is a Japanese-Asian fusion quick-service restaurant in Whistler's Creekside neighbourhood, open 7 days a week and serving ramen, Korean fried chicken, poke bowls, and Thai curry. It is part of a locally owned family of four Samurai restaurants across Whistler and Squamish, established in Creekside in 2006. The restaurant emphasizes eco-friendly practices, using compostable and recyclable takeout containers—an appeal for environmentally conscious cyclists on tour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at whistlersamurai.com confirms 'Samurai Bowl' is the Creekside location of a two-location Whistler Japanese restaurant brand. Address (2011 Innsbruck Dr, Whistler, BC V8E 0N3) and phone (604-935-0055) were sourced entirely from the website's contact page since OSM carries neither. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website's dedicated takeout ordering section; vegetarian options are confirmed by the About page ('family friendly and vegetarian options'); no evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, wi-fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM carries no address or phone; both were sourced solely from the website's contact page and should be verified on-the-ground.
